title: Sunday evening
instructions: Omar pazar akşamını anlatıyor. Sıraya ve saatlere dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Sunday evening, I am at home with my family.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We have dinner at six o'clock.

script.speaker: s
script.text: After dinner, I do my homework.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Then we watch a film together.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I go to bed at nine because I have school on Monday.
